passage.label: Al-Baqarah — universal salvation for believers across communities; covenant at Mount Sinai raised above them

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُواْ وَٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـِٔينَ مَنۡ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
وَإِذۡ أَخَذۡنَا مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ ٱلطُّورَ خُذُواْ مَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكُم بِقُوَّةٖ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُونَ

mainSubject.label: Universal reward for all who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do righteousness regardless of community affiliation; covenant with Bani Israel at Mount Sinai commanding them to hold firmly to what was given and remember its contents for taqwa

subordinateSubjects.label: Believers, Jews, Christians, Sabians who believe in Allah and Last Day and do good: reward with Lord, no fear, no grief
Command: take what We gave you with strength/determination
Command: remember what is in it so perhaps you attain taqwa

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Taqwa as intended outcome of holding to divine scripture
Freedom from fear and grief as reward for true faith and righteous action

relationships.label: Covenantal relationship between Allah and Bani Israel at Sinai

notes: Pass A pilot 5, passage 11/4. Key ecumenical verse (2:62) establishing salvation criteria beyond communal identity. Transition from wilderness narrative to covenant renewal.
